arStrings.szText: When you lose at least {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life, you kill Lesser Demons that each absorb up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life in damage.
